reason: Provides an integrated issue kanban board with a sidebar view, local managed service, and agent commands for reading and updating project work items.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供集成式问题看板、侧边栏界面和用于管理项目任务的智能体命令。
summaries.en: Provides an integrated issue kanban board in DeepSeek Harness with a sidebar interface and agent commands for managing project tasks.

capabilities: Reads and writes projects, issues, comments, and relations
Stores taskboard data in a local SQLite directory
Provides an agent tool for task and service operations
Displays the board through a local loopback web interface
